headlines.summary: The FDA approved a supplemental indication for Casgevy (exagamglogene autotemcel), a CRISPR-based gene therapy, expanding its use to children aged 2 years and older with sickle cell disease or transfusion-dependent β thalassemia. SAXPY.title: Sampo appoints Diane Michelberger Head of Investor Relations
SAXPY.summary: Sampo Group has appointed Diane Michelberger as Head of Investor Relations, effective early Q4 2026. Michelberger brings extensive insurance industry experience, having served as Head of Investor Relations at Admiral Group since 2023 and previously holding positions at Aviva and AXA UK.

MGDDY.title: Michelin : Déclaration des transactions sur actions propres - 2 juillet 2026
MGDDY.summary: Michelin has completed its acquisition of Tex Tech Industries to strengthen its Polymer Composite Solutions business. Additionally, Michelin North America is planning a reorganization of BFGoodrich Tires manufacturing operations in the United States.

TMOAY.title: TomTom and Transit Technologies partner to deliver enhanced fleet and logistics operations
TMOAY.summary: TomTom announced a strategic partnership with Transit Technologies to integrate TomTom Orbis Maps and Live Traffic into Transit Technologies' fleet and logistics solutions. This integration will provide real-time routing intelligence and traffic-aware decision-making for transit, paratransit, and non-emergent medical transportation networks across the United States and Central America.

CELH.title: INVESTOR ALERT: Pomerantz Law Firm Investigates Claims On Behalf of Investors of Celsius Holdings, Inc. - CELH
CELH.summary: Pomerantz LLP is investigating potential securities fraud claims against Celsius Holdings following a Texas Attorney General investigation into whether the company and its subsidiary Alani Nutrition misrepresented the safety of high-caffeine energy drinks marketed to children and teens. The announcement triggered a 7.53% stock price decline on June 4, 2026.

MU.title: MEXC Launches TradFi Gala With 1,000,000 USDT Reward Pool
MU.summary: MEXC has launched the TradFi Gala, a month-long Futures trading campaign offering 1,000,000 USDT in rewards with 0-fee trading on selected pairs. The campaign reflects surging demand for AI infrastructure and semiconductor stocks, with MEXC's May Stock Futures volume increasing 105% month-over-month and Micron (MU) Futures volume surging 1,002%.

NFLX.title: France Licensing Day Breaks Records, Moves to New Paris Location in Biggest Edition Yet
NFLX.summary: France Licensing Day 2026 achieved record attendance with 550+ attendees and 55 exhibitors at its new Paris venue on June 30. The event facilitated 500+ meetings between major brands including Paramount, Netflix, Warner Bros. Discovery, and Mattel with French retailers and licensees. The 8th annual Licensing International France Awards recognized excellence across 17 categories, with winners including Mattel's Barbie collaboration and Netflix's LEGO One Piece line.

ISADY.title: ISS extends and expands partnership with public healthcare provider in Southern Europe
ISADY.summary: ISS has extended and expanded its partnership with a public healthcare provider in Southern Europe, with an annual contract value of approximately DKK 100 million. The agreement includes expanded cleaning services and increased scope across the customer's sites, with a two-year duration and option for further extension, commencing July 2026.

INSD.title: Insta and CHAOS Industries Partner to Counter Rising Aerial Threats in Europe
INSD.summary: U.S. defense technology company CHAOS Industries and Finnish technology company Insta announced a partnership to integrate CHAOS's distributed sensing and radar capabilities into Insta's AirC2 command-and-control system. The collaboration aims to address unmanned aerial system threats in Finland and Northern Europe through cost-effective, layered air defense solutions, with a joint demonstration planned for Finland in the coming months.

MHK.title: Mohawk Industries, Inc. le invita a unirse a la conferencia telefónica sobre los resultados financieros del segundo trimestre
MHK.summary: Mohawk Industries announced a CEO succession plan with Paul De Cock appointed as Chief Executive Officer effective September 30, 2026. Current CEO Jeff Lorberbaum will retire after a 50-year career and transition to serve as Chairman of the Board.

ELTX.title: Elicio Therapeutics Announces Pricing of $15 Million Registered Direct Offering
ELTX.summary: Elicio Therapeutics (Nasdaq: ELTX), a clinical-stage biotech company, announced a registered direct offering of 4.38 million shares expected to raise approximately $15 million gross proceeds. The company plans to use the funds to support Phase 1 clinical development of ELI-002 7P in metastatic pancreatic cancer, pipeline advancement, and general corporate purposes. The offering is expected to close on or about July 6, 2026.

ELTX.title: Elicio Therapeutics Added to Russell 2000® and Russell 3000® Indexes
ELTX.summary: Elicio Therapeutics (ELTX), a clinical-stage biotech company developing immunotherapies for KRAS-driven cancers, was added to the Russell 2000 and Russell 3000 indexes as of June 26, 2026. The company is advancing its lead candidate ELI-002 7P, an off-the-shelf cancer immunotherapy targeting common KRAS mutations. However, the Phase 2 AMPLIFY-7P trial did not meet its primary endpoint of disease-free survival, prompting Elicio to refine its Phase 3 development strategy and initiate a Phase 1 study in metastatic pancreatic cancer.

GOOG.title: AI/R Avenue Code Achieves Google’s Gemini Enterprise Competency and Accelerates Enterprise Adoption of Agentic AI
GOOG.summary: AI/R Avenue Code, a subsidiary of AI/R, has achieved Google's Gemini Enterprise competency, validating its technical expertise in deploying advanced AI solutions in enterprise environments. The company has successfully implemented solutions for financial and logistics sectors, demonstrating measurable business impact including significant time savings and improved operational efficiency.

GOOG.title: Robinhood and Bitget Wallet Partner to Bring 24/7 Stock Token Trading Onchain
GOOG.summary: Bitget Wallet has announced a strategic partnership with Robinhood Crypto and integrated Robinhood Chain, an Ethereum Layer 2 network for tokenized real-world assets. The integration enables Bitget Wallet's 90 million users to trade 90+ Stock Tokens including NVIDIA, Google, and Apple without requiring a brokerage account, marking a significant step in bringing traditional finance infrastructure onchain.

GOOG.title: Rising AI and HPC Workloads Propel Demand for Liquid Cooling in European Data Centers
GOOG.summary: Europe's data center construction market is expected to grow from $16.99 billion in 2025 to $58.74 billion by 2031, driven by liquid cooling adoption for AI workloads, digitalization, cloud expansion, and government support. Hyperscale data centers lead investments, with Western Europe and the Nordics dominating due to renewable energy availability and strategic locations.

GOOG.title: Tech drove down mishandled bag rates by 23% in 2025, but mishandling still costs the industry $6.3 billion a year
GOOG.summary: The aviation industry achieved a 23% reduction in baggage mishandling rates in 2025 through digital transformation, bringing rates below pre-pandemic levels. However, mishandled baggage still costs the industry $6.3 billion annually, with each bag averaging $260 in costs. Real-time data sharing, AI routing, and biometric bag drop technologies are driving improvements, though transfers remain the primary mishandling driver at 39% of cases.

GOOG.title: SCOTUS Tracks NCLA Arguments to Place Guardrails on Government’s Sweeping Surveillance Scheme
GOOG.summary: The U.S. Supreme Court ruled in Chatrie v. U.S. that government collection of location data via geofences constitutes a Fourth Amendment search, overturning a Fourth Circuit decision. The ruling reaffirms the 2018 Carpenter v. United States decision that individuals have a legitimate expectation of privacy in their location history, even when collected through third-party tech companies.

GOOG.title: Password Management Market to Reach $42.21 Billion by 2035 as Cyberattacks and Identity Security Risks Drive Enterprise Adoption | Report by SNS Insider
GOOG.summary: The global password management market is projected to grow from $5.55 billion in 2025 to $42.21 billion by 2035, driven by rising cyberattacks, data breaches, remote work expansion, and regulatory compliance requirements. The U.S. market is expected to reach $12.53 billion while Europe reaches $2.63 billion by 2035. Large enterprises currently dominate the market, with BFSI and healthcare sectors leading adoption.

EMBC.title: ROSEN, A GLOBALLY RECOGNIZED FIRM, Encourages Embecta Corp. Investors to Secure Counsel Before Important Deadline in Securities Class Action – EMBC
EMBC.summary: Rosen Law Firm has filed a class action lawsuit against Embecta Corp. on behalf of investors who purchased common stock between November 25, 2025 and May 4, 2026. The lawsuit alleges that Embecta made false and misleading statements about its fiscal results and guidance, particularly regarding its pen needle business, which it described as 'incredibly resolute' before subsequently missing expectations and cutting 2026 fiscal guidance. Investors who purchased shares during this period may be entitled to compensation. The deadline to serve as lead plaintiff is August 17, 2026.

EMBC.title: Bronstein, Gewirtz & Grossman LLC Urges Embecta Corp. Investors to Act: Class Action Filed Alleging Investor Harm
EMBC.summary: A class action lawsuit has been filed against Embecta Corp. alleging that company executives made materially false and misleading statements about business operations and guidance during the Class Period (November 25, 2025 - May 4, 2026). The complaint claims Embecta misrepresented its pen needle business as 'incredibly resolute' before missing Q2 2026 guidance and cutting full-year guidance, with revenue declining over 14% versus guidance of flat to 2% decline.

EMBC.title: GPK DEADLINE: ROSEN, A LONGSTANDING FIRM, Encourages Graphic Packaging Holding Company Investors with Losses in Excess of $100K to Secure Counsel Before Important July 6 Deadline in Securities Class Action – GPK
EMBC.summary: Rosen Law Firm has filed securities class action lawsuits against Graphic Packaging Holding Company, Zoetis Inc., and Embecta Corp. The lawsuit against Graphic Packaging alleges the company made false statements regarding inventory management, demand, costs, and financial guidance during the Class Period of February 4, 2025 to February 2, 2026. Investors with losses exceeding $100,000 are encouraged to join the class action before the July 6, 2026 deadline.

EMBC.title: ROSEN, A LEADING INVESTOR RIGHTS LAW FIRM, Encourages Embecta Corp. Investors to Secure Counsel Before Important Deadline in Securities Class Action – EMBC
EMBC.summary: Rosen Law Firm has filed class action lawsuits against Embecta Corp. for allegedly making false statements about fiscal results and pen needle business performance, cutting 2026 guidance. The firm is also investigating claims against Zoetis Inc. and Disc Medicine Inc. Investors who purchased securities during specified periods may be eligible for compensation.

TLX.title: FDA Alignment to Advance ProstACT Global Phase 3 Trial
TLX.summary: Telix Pharmaceuticals announced successful alignment with the FDA on the Part 2 protocol design of its ProstACT Global Phase 3 trial for TLX591-Tx in metastatic castration resistant prostate cancer. The FDA confirmed that Part 1 safety data is sufficient to progress Part 2 into the U.S., where the therapeutic candidate will be tested in combination with three standard-of-care therapies. The company plans to submit an IND amendment to initiate Part 2 enrollment in the U.S.

IRON.title: Disc Medicine Investor News: If You Have Suffered Losses in Disc Medicine, Inc. (NASDAQ: IRON), You Are Encouraged to Contact The Rosen Law Firm About Your Rights
IRON.summary: The Rosen Law Firm is investigating potential securities claims against Disc Medicine, Inc. (NASDAQ: IRON) following an FDA Complete Response Letter on February 13, 2026, regarding its bitopertin program. The FDA stated it could not approve the new drug application due to uncertainties requiring additional evidence. The stock price fell 22% on the news, and investors who suffered losses are encouraged to join a prospective class action lawsuit.

The company is accused of understating competition for U.S. Space Force contracts and overstating its business prospects. Investors who suffered losses during this period have until July 27, 2026 to request lead plaintiff status.

AVAV.title: AVAV IMPORTANT DEADLINE: ROSEN, HIGHLY REGARDED INVESTOR COUNSEL, Encourages AeroVironment, Inc. Investors with Losses in Excess of $100K to Secure Counsel Before Important Deadline in Securities Class Action - AVAV

BX.title: GNI Group Completes Acquisition of AYUMI Pharmaceutical
BX.summary: GNI Group Ltd. has completed its acquisition of Ayumi Pharmaceutical Holdings Co., Ltd. from Blackstone and other shareholders for approximately JPY 44.8 billion. The acquisition marks GNI Group's entry into Japan's pharmaceutical market, establishing what the company calls its 'Second Founding Phase' as a global biopharma company. Ayumi Pharmaceutical, with JPY 38.5 billion in annual revenue and over 80% market share in acetaminophen products, will operate as a wholly owned subsidiary while maintaining its brand names and product portfolio.

BX.summary: Digital Realty announced the pricing of an underwritten public offering of 12.3 million shares by Blackstone affiliates at $185 per share. GeneDx shares fell 49.2% on the news. Investors have until August 3, 2026 to file lead plaintiff applications.

WGS.title: HBSS Investigates Claims Against GeneDx Holdings (WGS) in Securities Class Action Suit Following Massive Impairment Charge

The company's stock collapsed 49% on May 5, 2026, following a disastrous Q1 2026 earnings report that included a $31.2 million impairment charge on the Fabric Genomics unit, representing 94% of the acquisition cost. GeneDx also reported a tenfold increase in net loss, missed revenue targets, and slashed 2026 guidance by 12%.

TOL.summary: Toll Brothers opened its third model home, the Canterwood Contemporary, at Camas Meadows Crossing luxury townhome community in Camas, Washington. The community features townhomes ranging from 2,430 square feet with 3-5 bedrooms priced from the upper $500,000s, offering quick move-in options and proximity to outdoor recreation, shopping, and major metropolitan areas.

GTM.title: UPDATE: Levi & Korsinsky, LLP Notifies Investors It Has Filed a Complaint to Recover Losses Suffered by Purchasers of ZoomInfo Technologies Inc. Securities and Sets a Lead Plaintiff Deadline of August 24, 2026
GTM.summary: Law firm Levi & Korsinsky has filed a class action lawsuit against ZoomInfo Technologies Inc. on behalf of investors who purchased securities between November 3, 2025 and May 11, 2026. The lawsuit alleges the company made materially false and misleading statements about its growth, customer retention, and market trends while concealing adverse facts. ZoomInfo's stock price fell approximately 33% (from $6.04 to $4.06 per share) following the announcement of disappointing Q1 2026 results and reduced 2026 guidance. The lead plaintiff deadline is August 24, 2026.

GTM.title: Bronstein, Gewirtz & Grossman LLC Urges ZoomInfo Technologies Inc. Investors to Act: Class Action Filed Alleging Investor Harm
GTM.summary: A class action lawsuit has been filed against ZoomInfo Technologies Inc. (NASDAQ: GTM) alleging securities fraud. The lawsuit claims defendants made false statements about revenue guidance and business fundamentals during the Class Period (November 3, 2025 - May 11, 2026). ZoomInfo slashed full-year revenue guidance by approximately $62 million on May 11, 2026, causing the stock to plummet 33% from $6.04 to $4.06 per share.

INVU.title: UPDATE - Investview Launches MyLife Wellness Focused on Health Optimization
INVU.summary: Investview announced MyLife Wellness, a health and wellness e-commerce platform under its Conectiv lifestyle optimization brand. The platform offers science-backed supplements, skincare, and coffee products with bundled packages. Conectiv members receive discounted pricing and can resell products for additional income. However, the forward-looking statements reveal significant operational challenges, including revenue reductions in 2025-2026 and dependence on uncontracted independent distributors for growth.

CELZ.summary: Creative Medical Technology Holdings (NASDAQ: CELZ) announced agreements to exercise existing warrants for $4.5 million in gross proceeds. The company will issue new unregistered warrants to purchase up to 5.58 million shares at $1.60 per share, pending shareholder approval. Net proceeds will be used for working capital and general corporate purposes.

TLRY.title: Breckenridge Distillery Earns Double Gold for Rum Cask Finish at New York International Spirits Competition
TLRY.summary: Breckenridge Distillery, a subsidiary of Tilray Brands, won Double Gold and a 96-point score for its Rum Cask Finish whiskey at the New York International Spirits Competition. The distillery was also named Colorado Distillery of the Year for the sixth consecutive time and earned seven gold-or-better medals across its product portfolio.

TLRY.title: BrewDog and Tilray Beer Add Canada to The World's Biggest Bar Tab as Canada Advances to the Next Round
TLRY.summary: BrewDog and Tilray Brands announced an expansion of their £1 million bar tab promotion to include Canada after the country advanced in the 2026 international men's football tournament. If Canada, England, or the United States reaches the final, fans wearing eligible team jerseys can claim up to two free pints per person at participating BrewDog pubs and Tilray-owned brewpubs on a first-come, first-served basis starting July 20.

UPYY.summary: UPAY Inc. WETO.summary: Wetour Robotics (NASDAQ: WETO) unveiled a live demonstration of its Conductor sEMG neural wristband, which decodes muscle signals into real-time 3D hand pose and converts gestures to text commands. The technology, trained on Meta's open emg2pose dataset, is engineered for affordable on-device deployment using 8-channel sensors at 250 Hz. Wetour positions Conductor as part of its Orchestra platform to enable human-intent data collection for robotics and physical AI applications while maintaining privacy through edge processing.

NTNX.title: Nutanix and the North Carolina School of Science and Mathematics Partner to Expand Computer Science Access Across North Carolina
NTNX.summary: Nutanix has committed $250,000 to establish an endowed professorship at the North Carolina School of Science and Mathematics (NCSSM) to expand computer science education across the state. BRSP.summary: DLP Real Estate Capital announced the closing of a $118 million refinancing for its Houston Portfolio comprising 605 multifamily units across two communities. Growth is driven by rising health consciousness, demand for high-protein diets, plant-based proteins, and e-commerce expansion. North America leads the market while Asia-Pacific is the fastest-growing region. Key players include Nestle, PepsiCo, and Tyson Foods, with recent innovations in clean-label and functional protein snacks.

JG.title: Aurora Mobile’s JPush Partners with CICC Wealth Management to Enhance the Digital Wealth Management Experience
JG.summary: Aurora Mobile announced a partnership with CICC Wealth Management to deploy its JPush intelligent push notification solution within the CICC Wealth Management App. The collaboration aims to strengthen the app's communication infrastructure with reliable, compliant, and personalized message delivery for investors, addressing challenges in wealth management platforms such as high reliability requirements for transaction notifications and precise information targeting.

JOYY.title: JOYY Recognized as “Most Honored Company” in Extel’s 2026 Asia Executive Team Survey
JOYY.summary: JOYY Inc. has been named a 'Most Honored Company' by Extel for the second consecutive year and eighth year overall in the 2026 Asia Executive Team Survey. The company secured top-three rankings in five categories including Best CEO, Best CFO, and Best Investor Relations, reflecting strong leadership and investor relations performance in the competitive Internet sector.

GSIT.title: GSI Technology to Participate in Canaccord Genuity 46th Annual Growth Conference on August 12, 2026
GSIT.summary: GSI Technology announced its participation in the Canaccord Genuity 46th Annual Growth Conference on August 12, 2026, in Boston. CEO Lee-Lean Shu and VP Didier Lasserre will present the company's Associative Processing Unit (APU) technology and provide updates on proof-of-concept programs and early-stage deployments in defense, smart infrastructure, and intelligent surveillance markets.

MAR.title: Residence Inn by Marriott Boston Marlborough, Massachusetts Completes a Full Renovation
MAR.summary: Crestline Hotels & Resorts announced the completion of a comprehensive renovation at The Residence Inn by Marriott Boston Marlborough, MA. The 112-suite hotel received upgrades including contemporary design, new furnishings, bathroom improvements, and enhanced public spaces. The fitness center was upgraded with new equipment, and the breakfast area and pool area were also renovated.

GIL.title: INVESTIGATION NOTICE: Girard Sharp Law Firm Encourages Former HanesBrands Investors Who Received Gildan (NYSE: GIL) Shares in Connection with Gildan’s Acquisition of HanesBrands in December 2025 to Contact the Firm
GIL.summary: Girard Sharp LLP is investigating potential securities claims on behalf of former HanesBrands investors who received Gildan shares in the December 2025 acquisition. Gildan's stock price has declined significantly since the merger closed, prompting the law firm to seek affected investors for a class action lawsuit.

ZLNDY.title: Releasing Hopsworks 5.0 - Introducing the Coding Data and AI Stack
ZLNDY.summary: Hopsworks launched version 5.0, a unified AI and Data platform featuring embedded coding agents, development containers, and a redesigned UI. The release includes native SQL query capabilities via Trino, Apache Superset dashboarding, expanded data integration, column-level access control, and enhanced model registry with Hugging Face integration. The platform is now generally available for both SaaS and enterprise deployments.

QFIN.title: Qfin Holdings Announces Results of Annual General Meeting
QFIN.summary: Qfin Holdings, Inc. (NASDAQ: QFIN; HKEx: 3660) announced that shareholders have approved the re-appointment of Deloitte Touche Tohmatsu and Deloitte Touche Tohmatsu Certified Public Accountants LLP as the company's auditors at its annual general meeting held on June 30, 2026. The auditors will serve until the next annual general meeting, with the board authorized to determine their remuneration for the year ending December 31, 2026.

JEM.title: 707 Cayman Holdings Appoints New Executive Director
JEM.summary: 707 Cayman Holdings Limited (Nasdaq: JEM) announced the appointment of Robin Hoksnes Karlsen as an executive director. Karlsen, founder and CEO of AMIHAN Innovations Ltd., brings over a decade of experience in real estate investment and digital assets, with expertise in blockchain tokenization and RWA (Real World Asset) technology. The appointment supports 707's strategic expansion into AI-powered blockchain-enabled supply-chain technologies.

WTW.title: WTW speeds strategic life insurer decisions with addition of GPU-support in RiskAgility Financial Modeller
WTW.summary: WTW announced GPU-support enhancements to its RiskAgility Financial Modeller platform for life and health insurers. The upgrade combines GPU acceleration with the Gen-2 engine and AI capabilities to enable faster model generation, with early testing showing up to 100x cost savings in some situations. The platform now allows users to choose between GPU and CPU execution based on their modeling needs.

HMKIY.title: Correction: Huhtamaki appoints Thomas Morin as President, Fiber Packaging, and member of the Global Executive Team
HMKIY.summary: Huhtamaki has appointed Thomas Morin as President of Fiber Packaging and member of the Global Executive Team, effective September 1, 2026. Morin brings over 25 years of global packaging industry experience from TC Transcontinental, Amcor, Alcan, and Pechiney. He succeeds Sara Engber, who was promoted to President, North America in March 2026.

HMKIY.summary: Huhtamaki has appointed Thomas Morin as President of Fiber Packaging and member of the Global Executive Team, effective September 1, 2026. BLK.title: Syensqo - Participation notification by BlackRock Inc.
BLK.summary: BlackRock Inc. has notified Syensqo that it crossed the 3% threshold for direct voting rights on June 19, 2026, holding 3.07% in direct voting rights and 0.97% in equivalent financial instruments, for a total of 4.04%. KBCSY.title: KBC Group: KBC appoints Kris Vervaet as Group CIO
KBCSY.summary: KBC Group announces the appointment of Kris Vervaet as Chief Information Officer and Executive Committee member, effective September 1, 2026, subject to regulatory approval. He succeeds Erik Luts, who retires after a 38-year career instrumental in KBC's digital transformation. Vervaet brings over 30 years of technology and digital transformation experience from telecom, energy, and finance sectors.

JCDXY.title: JCDecaux renouvelle pour 8 ans le contrat publicitaire de l’aéroport de Londres Heathrow
JCDXY.summary: JCDecaux has renewed its advertising contract with London Heathrow Airport for 8 years, effective January 1, 2027, extending a partnership of over 25 years. The contract covers management of more than 680 digital screens and premium advertising devices at the world's most connected airport, which handled a record 84.5 million passengers in 2025.

BVVBY.title: BUREAU VERITAS - In line with the LEAP | 28 portfolio rotation strategy, Bureau Veritas signs an agreement to sell its Oil & Petrochemicals and Coal Testing and Inspection business
BVVBY.summary: Bureau Veritas has entered exclusive negotiations to sell its Oil & Petrochemicals and Coal testing and inspection business to Triton Partners for EUR 470 million as part of its LEAP | 28 portfolio rotation strategy. The business generated approximately EUR 450 million in revenue in 2025 but grew slower than the group and was margin dilutive. The transaction, expected to close by end of Q1 2027, represents approximately 20% portfolio rotation and will allow Bureau Veritas to redeploy proceeds toward higher-growth and higher-margin businesses.

BVVBY.title: BUREAU VERITAS - Conformément à sa stratégie de rotation du portefeuille LEAP | 28, Bureau Veritas signe un accord en vue de céder ses activités d’essais et d’inspection de Produits Pétroliers & Pétrochimiques et Charbon
BVVBY.summary: Bureau Veritas has entered into exclusive negotiations with Triton Partners to sell its petroleum products, petrochemicals, and coal testing and inspection business for €470 million. The divestment is part of the company's LEAP|28 portfolio rotation strategy to focus on higher-growth, higher-margin activities. The transaction, representing approximately 20% of the portfolio rotation, is expected to close by Q1 2027 and will be neutral to slightly positive for earnings while improving organic growth and operational margins.

MHGVY.title: Mowi enters into a Share Purchase Agreement to divest its 9k GWT salmon farming operations in Canada East
MHGVY.summary: Mowi has agreed to divest its 9,000 GWT salmon farming operations in Canada East to Cooke Inc. for CAD 225 million on a debt-free basis. The transaction, expected to close in H2 2026, will reduce Mowi's 2026 volume guidance from 605k GWT to 600k GWT and result in a write-down of approximately CAD 140 million. The divestment is part of Mowi's strategy to improve its farming portfolio and focus on core geographies.

ABBV.title: New study examines real-world switching patterns after patients transition from Humira to biosimilars
ABBV.summary: A study of nearly 68,000 patients found that adalimumab biosimilar adoption increased substantially following formulary changes in the US, with 17.7% of patients switching from originator Humira to biosimilars. However, 16% of those who switched subsequently returned to the originator product. Older adults, women, and patients with ankylosing spondylitis were more likely to switch back.

SIGEY.title: Sigenergy Breaks Ground on Phase II Intelligent Energy Center and Joint Venture Production Facility in Nantong
SIGEY.summary: Sigenergy officially broke ground on June 29, 2026, on Phase II of its Nantong Intelligent Energy Center and a joint venture production facility with Xianghua Hardware Technology. The expansion will bring the manufacturing base to nearly 400,000 square meters, serving as a global hub for residential, commercial, industrial, and utility-scale energy storage products. The company plans to integrate AI and digital systems across production, quality control, and logistics.

CALM.title: Cal-Maine Foods Reaches Resolution with U.S. Department of Justice and 17 States’ Attorneys General
CALM.summary: Cal-Maine Foods, the largest U.S. egg producer, has agreed to settle antitrust claims from the DOJ and 17 state attorneys general regarding alleged price manipulation through a cooperative. The company denies wrongdoing and faces no fines from the DOJ, but agreed to donate 30 million eggs and pay $1.5 million to states. Cal-Maine exited the cooperative in May 2024 and cooperated fully with the 15-month investigation.

ERO.title: Ero Copper Announces Voting Results of Annual General and Special Meeting of Shareholders
ERO.summary: Ero Copper Corp. held its Annual General and Special Meeting on June 29, 2026, with 82.98% shareholder attendance. All items of business were approved with strong support, including the re-election of ten directors, reappointment of KPMG LLP as auditor, and approval of amended stock option and share unit plans. The advisory vote on executive compensation received 98.64% approval.

NVCT.title: Nuvectis Pharma Announces Pricing of $100 Million Public Offering of Common Stock
NVCT.summary: Nuvectis Pharma (Nasdaq: NVCT), a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company, announced the pricing of an underwritten public offering of 5 million shares at $20.00 per share, generating $100 million in gross proceeds. The company plans to use the funds to advance development of its pipeline candidates NXP100, NXP200, and NXP900, hire personnel, and cover operational expenses. The offering is expected to close on July 1, 2026.

VSH.title: Vishay Intertechnology Announces Pricing of Public Offering of Common Stock
VSH.summary: Vishay Intertechnology announced an underwritten public offering of 15 million shares at $50 per share, raising approximately $750 million in gross proceeds. The company plans to use net proceeds to accelerate growth initiatives and reduce borrowings under its senior secured credit facility. The offering is expected to close on July 1, 2026, with J.P. Morgan serving as lead book-running manager.

MAMA.title: Mama’s Creations Announces Pricing of $100 Million Public Offering of Common Stock
MAMA.summary: Mama's Creations, Inc. (NASDAQ: MAMA) announced the pricing of an underwritten public offering of 5,555,556 shares at $18.00 per share, generating approximately $100 million in gross proceeds. The offering is expected to close on July 1, 2026, with proceeds intended for working capital, general corporate purposes, and potential acquisitions of complementary businesses.

ROK.title: Manufacturing Execution System (MES) Market Expected to Reach US$ 44.67 Billion at 13.3% CAGR by 2034
ROK.summary: The global Manufacturing Execution System (MES) market is projected to grow from US$ 14.47 billion in 2025 to US$ 44.67 billion by 2034, driven by Industry 4.0 adoption, operational efficiency needs, and regulatory compliance requirements. Asia Pacific is expected to dominate with over 60% market share, while cloud-based solutions represent the fastest-growing segment at 15.2% CAGR in North America.

RAY.title: Raytech Holding Limited Announces Closing of Approximately $6.2 Million Registered Direct Offering of its Ordinary Shares
RAY.summary: Raytech Holding Limited (NASDAQ: RAY) closed a registered direct offering of 3,149,832 ordinary shares at $1.97 per share, raising approximately $6.2 million. The company plans to use net proceeds for general corporate purposes, strategic expansion into personal health care electronics, and integration costs related to its acquisition of Worry Free Group (Hong Kong) Limited.

PRIM.title: SHAREHOLDER ALERT: Hub Group, Inc. Sued for Securities Law Violations; Investors Should Contact Block & Leviton To Learn How They Might Recover Their Losses
PRIM.summary: Hub Group, Inc. faces a securities fraud lawsuit after restating financial statements due to approximately $77 million in understatements of purchased transportation costs and accounts payable. The company's stock fell 18% in February 2026 and an additional 13% in May 2026 following disclosure of material misstatements in its 2023, 2024, and 2025 financial reports. Investors who purchased shares between April 28, 2023, and May 11, 2026, may be eligible to recover losses.

PRIM.title: Levi & Korsinsky Announces Investigation of Securities Claims Against Primoris Services Corporation (PRIM)
PRIM.summary: Primoris Services Corporation (PRIM) stock plunged 21.6% on June 22, 2026, after the company slashed its FY 2026 net-income guidance by approximately 70%, from $223-234 million to $71-101 million. The dramatic revision, attributed to cost overruns and schedule delays on six renewables projects, contradicted management's optimistic guidance from just six weeks prior. The law firm Levi & Korsinsky is investigating potential securities law violations on behalf of investors who purchased PRIM shares at artificially inflated prices.

TIGR.title: ROSEN, TOP RANKED GLOBAL COUNSEL, Encourages First Solar, Inc. Investors to Secure Counsel Before Important Deadline in Securities Class Action – FSLR
TIGR.summary: Rosen Law Firm has filed securities class action lawsuits against First Solar, Inc., Veritone, Inc., and UP Fintech Holding Limited. The First Solar lawsuit alleges the company made materially false statements regarding its capacity to manage U.S. tariff policy impacts and overstated projected performance. Investors who purchased securities during specified class periods are encouraged to join the litigation before the August 24, 2026 deadline for lead plaintiff consideration.

VERI.title: ROSEN, TOP RANKED GLOBAL COUNSEL, Encourages First Solar, Inc. Investors to Secure Counsel Before Important Deadline in Securities Class Action – FSLR

VERI.summary: Rosen Law Firm is alerting Veritone, Inc. investors who purchased securities between October 14, 2025 and April 14, 2026 about an important July 20, 2026 deadline to join a securities class action lawsuit. The lawsuit alleges that Veritone made false statements regarding its financial reporting, inaccurately recorded revenue and costs, overstated assets, and maintained deficient internal controls, leading to required financial statement restatements.

VERI.title: Levi & Korsinsky Reminds Veritone, Inc. Investors of the Pending Class Action Lawsuit With a Lead Plaintiff Deadline of July 20, 2026 - VERI
VERI.summary: A class action lawsuit has been filed against Veritone, Inc. alleging securities fraud for incorporating overstated Q3 2025 financial results into an October 2025 prospectus. The company allegedly inflated revenue by approximately $2.2 million and misclassified accounts receivable and other comprehensive income. Veritone later admitted in April 2026 that its Q3 2025 financial statements should no longer be relied upon. Investors who purchased VERI stock between October 14, 2025 and April 14, 2026 may be eligible to join the lawsuit with a lead plaintiff deadline of July 20, 2026.

VERI.title: Bronstein, Gewirtz & Grossman LLC Urges Veritone, Inc. Investors to Act: Class Action Filed Alleging Investor Harm
VERI.summary: A class action lawsuit has been filed against Veritone, Inc. alleging that the company made false and misleading statements regarding its financial performance during the period from October 14, 2025 to April 14, 2026. The complaint claims Veritone inaccurately recorded revenue and costs, overstated financial metrics, and maintained deficient internal controls, requiring a restatement of financial statements. Investors who purchased Veritone securities during this period are encouraged to join the lawsuit, with a lead plaintiff deadline of July 20, 2026.

ARQT.title: FDA Approves Arcutis’ ZORYVE® (roflumilast) Cream 0.3% for the Treatment of Plaque Psoriasis in Children as Young as Age 2
ARQT.summary: The FDA has approved ZORYVE cream 0.3% for treating plaque psoriasis in children as young as age 2, marking the first once-daily, non-steroidal therapy for this indication. This is Arcutis' seventh FDA approval for ZORYVE in four years. The approval addresses a significant treatment gap for young children with plaque psoriasis, offering a steroid-free option suitable for use anywhere on the body with no duration restrictions.

PLMK.title: Plum Acquisition Corp. IV Announces Postponement of Extraordinary General Meeting of Shareholders
PLMK.summary: Plum Acquisition Corp. IV announced a postponement of its extraordinary general shareholder meeting from July 2 to July 10, 2026, to allow additional time for shareholder engagement. The redemption request deadline has been extended from June 30 to July 8, 2026. The meeting will be held at Greenberg Traurig offices in West Palm Beach, Florida.

OCFC.title: OceanFirst Financial Corp. Completes Previously  Announced Sale of $1.3 Billion of New York City Multifamily Loans
OCFC.summary: OceanFirst Financial Corp. completed the sale of $1.3 billion in multifamily loans, primarily from the NYC metropolitan area and largely subject to rent regulations. The transaction, which included approximately 1,400 loans originated by Flushing Bank (acquired via merger on June 1, 2026), reduces the company's exposure to rent-regulated properties to less than 2.5% of total assets. The sale price was consistent with initial valuation estimates.

TACH.title: OpenPayd Announces Filing of Registration Statement on Form F-4 in Connection with its Proposed Business Combination with Titan Acquisition Corp. (Nasdaq: TACH).
TACH.summary: OpenPayd Global Holdings Limited has filed a Form F-4 registration statement with the SEC for its proposed business combination with Titan Acquisition Corp (Nasdaq: TACH). The transaction is expected to result in OpenPayd becoming a publicly traded company on Nasdaq under ticker symbol 'OP' with an implied pro forma equity value exceeding $1 billion. The combined company expects to receive approximately $276 million in gross proceeds from Titan's trust account, with closing anticipated in Q4 2026, subject to customary closing conditions and shareholder approval.

DBVT.title: DBV Technologies Provides BLA Submission Update for the VIASKIN® Peanut Patch in Children Aged 4 through 7 Years; Working Collaboratively with FDA to Optimize Review Process in Preparation for Filing
DBVT.summary: DBV Technologies announced it has completed extensive discussions with the FDA regarding its Biologics License Application (BLA) for the VIASKIN® Peanut Patch in children aged 4-7 years. The FDA did not request additional data, but DBV will incorporate feedback on data organization and formatting before submitting the BLA in Q3 2026.

NOAH.title: Bron and Noah Partner to Bring Global Stablecoin On- and Off-Ramp Access to Self-Custody
NOAH.summary: Bron, a self-custody wallet using MPC-based security without seed phrases, has partnered with Noah, a global stablecoin payments infrastructure provider, to enable seamless on- and off-ramp capabilities. The partnership aims to bridge traditional finance with self-custody wallets, addressing a major barrier to mainstream crypto adoption by simplifying how users fund and withdraw from digital asset accounts.

HELE.title: HELE UPCOMING DEADLINE: Levi & Korsinsky Alerts Helen of Troy Limited Stockholders of Securities Class Action - Contact the Firm
HELE.summary: A securities class action has been filed against Helen of Troy Limited (HELE) on behalf of shareholders who purchased securities between April 24, 2024, and October 8, 2025. Two senior executives—former CEO Noel Geoffroy and Interim CEO/CFO Brian Grass—are named as individual defendants under Section 20(a) of the Securities Exchange Act for alleged misrepresentations regarding Project Pegasus, a restructuring initiative. The stock suffered three corrective declines, including a 27.7% single-day drop and a $414.4 million goodwill impairment. The deadline to apply for lead plaintiff appointment is August 3, 2026.

HELE.title: Bronstein, Gewirtz & Grossman LLC Urges Helen of Troy Limited Investors to Act: Class Action Filed Alleging Investor Harm
HELE.summary: A class action lawsuit has been filed against Helen of Troy Limited alleging that the company made materially false and misleading statements about its Project Pegasus initiative. The complaint claims the company overstated the project's success and cost-saving benefits while downplaying implementation issues, when in reality the project was not delivering promised efficiencies due to insufficient resources and budget. Investors who purchased Helen of Troy securities between April 24, 2024 and October 8, 2025 are encouraged to join the case, with a lead plaintiff deadline of August 3, 2026.

SIEB.title: Siebert Expands Access to Tokenized Securities Through New Collaboration with tZERO and Streamex
SIEB.summary: Siebert Financial Corp., through its subsidiary Muriel Siebert & Co., announced a collaboration with tZERO Group and Streamex Corp. to distribute GLDY, a gold-backed, yield-bearing tokenized security, to eligible accredited and institutional investors. The partnership integrates blockchain-enabled financial products into traditional brokerage services, with tZERO providing regulated digital securities infrastructure including custody, compliance, and secondary market services.

CPXXY.title: YMCA and Capital Power team up to send 600 kids to camp this summer
CPXXY.summary: YMCA of Northern Alberta and Capital Power announced a partnership to provide financial assistance for summer camp experiences. Capital Power has committed to a 3-year partnership to support the YMCA's programs, aiming to send 600 children to camp who couldn't otherwise afford it. The initiative also includes donations matched up to 50% through Rogers Birdies for Kids until August 31, 2026.

MCFT.title: MasterCraft & RealTruck Partner to Celebrate America’s 250th Anniversary with Restoration and Custom Build Project to Benefit National Military & First Responders Non-Profit Charity
MCFT.summary: MasterCraft Boat Company and RealTruck announced a collaboration to restore a 1975 MasterCraft Stars & Stripes boat and create a custom Chevrolet Colorado as part of America's 250th anniversary celebration. The truck-and-boat pairing will serve as a charitable fundraising centerpiece for Building Homes for Heroes, a nonprofit that builds mortgage-free homes for veterans and first responders. Country music artist Warren Zeiders joined the initiative to raise awareness and funds. The custom builds will be showcased at major events including the American Century Championship, SEMA 2026, and Barrett-Jackson auctions.

BAESY.title: Head-up Displays to Reach $13.7 Billion by 2030, Driven by Digital Cockpit Integration
BAESY.summary: The global head-up display (HUD) market is expected to grow from $6.9 billion in 2024 to $13.7 billion by 2030 at a 12.8% CAGR, driven by increasing adoption of ADAS, electric vehicles, and AI integration. Asia-Pacific leads with 44.5% market share, while key players include Continental AG, DENSO, Valeo, and Visteon. AVPT.title: AvePoint Research Reveals AI Visibility Gaps Have Nearly Tripled as AI Agents Scale and Almost Half of Enterprise Employees Now Rely on Agents Daily or Weekly
AVPT.summary: AvePoint's third annual State of AI Report reveals critical governance gaps in enterprise AI adoption. Visibility gaps for unsanctioned AI tools have nearly tripled to 17.6%, while 21.1% of organizations lack visibility into AI agent usage. Despite 82.7% of organizations expressing confidence in preventing unauthorized data access, 72% of confident organizations experienced unauthorized access incidents in the past year. Nearly 90% of organizations delayed AI deployments by six months due to security concerns, and 88.4% experienced at least one AI agent-related security breach. The report emphasizes that organizations need a 'trust layer' of visibility, governance, and enforceable control to safely scale AI.
